'''Sthonnart''' was a [[Major/Legends|major]] in the [[New Republic Defense Fleet/Legends|New Republic Defense Fleet]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In the year [[5 ABY/Legends|5.5 ABY]], Major Sthonnart served in the fleet under the command of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], the son of [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], who directed a full scale assault against the warlord [[Cronal|Shadowspawn]]. The major was stationed onboard the cruiser [[Justice (MC80 Star Cruiser)|''Justice'']] where it was destroyed moments later during the start of the [[Battle of Mindor|battle]] on [[Mindor/Legends|Mindor]]. Afterwards, Sthonnart moved with the survivors inside a cave and were to await further instructions from Skywalker.<ref name="LSSM" />
